Subject: Marketplace listing: metered vs trial SKUs + regional packaging decision

Team —

Following our product/ops sync, I want to lock in a decision for how we list CloudCo across AWS/Azure/GCP for the initial public rollout. This thread should capture the decision and action items so partner teams have a single source of truth. Key constraints we need to balance: co-sell readiness (partner playbook required by each cloud), trial experience (free trial SKU vs metered pay-as-you-go), and regional regulatory constraints (data residency / encryption keys for EU customers).

Options on the table (summary):
- Option A: Public metered SKUs on all three clouds (default listing). Pros: simplest to operationalize; supports usage-based billing. Cons: weaker free-trial funnel; additional telemetry mapping for co-sell.
- Option B: Public trial SKU in US + metered in EU/APAC (trial only where partner co-sell is strong). Pros: better conversion in pilot regions; Cons: introduces surface fragmentation and support complexity.
- Option C: Private Offer for enterprise pilots (all clouds) + public metered for self-serve. Pros: clean enterprise terms/co-sell; Cons: slower self-serve growth.

Specific asks for this thread:
1) Confirm which option we pick for CloudCo initial listing (they want trial in EU and public metered in US/Azure).
2) Decide region-by-region gating (we should list which AZ/regions to enable first).
3) Agree on the telemetry payload and marketplace usage IDs (needed by AWS/GCP to enable co-sell reports).
4) Action owners and deadlines so partner teams can start co-sell enablement.

Attachments: marketplace_matrix_v3.xlsx (proposal mapping), co-sell_checklist_v2.pdf, pricing_table_metered_vs_trial.csv

I propose a short conf call tomorrow 9:30 PT if any objections — otherwise I'll assume we proceed with my working recommendation (Option B, canary EU trial + public metered US/GCP).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: metered vs trial SKUs + regional packaging decision

Kimberly —

Thanks for laying this out. Quick thoughts inline: 

> Option A: Public metered SKUs on all three clouds
- Lean into this for speed-to-market. Metered reduces contract overhead. But we need to make sure billing reconciliation is solid for GCP (they have a different Marketplace metering token flow).

> Option B: Public trial SKU in US + metered in EU/APAC
- If CloudCo explicitly asked for EU trial, we should confirm whether local data processing is required for the trial. If yes, there's a spike in infra/ops cost.

> Option C: Private Offer for enterprise pilots + public metered for self-serve
- Strongly agree for strategic named accounts, but operationally we should limit private offers to deals > $50k ARR equivalent.

Telemetry: we must include the following in the marketplace usage record: account_id, marketplace_customer_id, region_code, tokenized_model_id, invoice_period_timestamps. I'll add a sample payload to the sheet.

Canary regions (proposal):
- US: us-west-2 (primary), us-east-1 (fallback)
- EU: eu-west-1 (canary), eu-central-1 (phase 2)
- APAC: asia-southeast1 (GCP) then ap-southeast-2 (Azure)

I'll join the 9:30 PT call.

-ben
Ben Carter
Director, Cloud GTM
Redwood Inference

All —

Agree with Ben's telemetry points. A couple of regulatory/pricing items to highlight from the EU angle: 
- For trial SKUs in EU we must offer the option for CloudCo to bring their own KMS or agree to our EU KMS key policy. That will change the onboarding checklist in the co-sell playbook.
- VAT handling: marketplace metered invoices are sometimes subject to different VAT flows depending on the customer's VAT registration. Our billing team needs to confirm whether the marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP) will surface VAT to us or the end customer.

Packaging approach suggestion (canary + fallbacks):
1) Launch Phase: US public metered across both AWS & GCP, EU trial only on AWS (per CloudCo request) — keep Azure as staging for month 1.
2) Month 2+: If EU trial metrics (conversion to paid within 14 days, trial failure rate < 6%) meet thresholds, open public metered in EU on AWS and enable Azure public listings.

Support/ops impacts: we need a dedicated runbook for trial customers that maps to the private-offer onboarding path in case CloudCo requests contract terms mid-trial. I'll draft the runbook skeleton and link to it in the drive.

-Lauren

- EU trial will be AWS-only for the initial canary; we will require CloudCo to sign the DPA and either accept Redwood EU KMS or supply BYOK before trial activation.
- Private Offers remain the path for named enterprise pilots (> $50k ARR equivalent).
